step_1_helper_initialization.action: Ensure libsys_core.so helper process is running and UDS sockets @uds_sys_v_, @uds_sys_a_, @uds_sys_c_, @uds_sys_t_ are ready

step_2_peerconnection_setup.action: Initialize PeerConnection, add video/audio tracks, create 3 outbound DataChannels, register OnDataChannel callback

step_3_offer_creation.action: Agent generates SDP Offer as the WebRTC initiating party

step_5_signaling_offer_dispatch.action: Dispatches Offer over WebSocket signaling relay to browser client

step_6_remote_answer_handling.action: Receives browser client SDP Answer from signaling server and applies it

step_7_ice_candidate_handling.action: Applies trickle ICE candidates received from browser client
